reading: Some of Britain's biggest stars spent four weeks engaged in a battle of wits on The Celebrity Traitors.
By Friday's final, the original field of 21 celebrities had been whittled down to seven.
Comedian Romesh Ranganathan and Heartstopper actor Sebastian “Bash” Croft ultimately emerged as the two winners.
The pair shared an £83,000 charity prize after the contestants banished the last two traitors, Maya Jama and King Kenny.
Their winnings will be divided between two refugee charities, the Refugee Council and Choose Love.
Kenny had reached the endgame, the final stage, by turning on his fellow traitor Maya at the last round table.
Singer James Blunt joined Kenny, Romesh and Bash in the endgame, where the group had to decide whether any traitors were left.
When a vote left Kenny and James tied, Bash convinced Romesh to banish Kenny, thereby securing victory for the faithful contestants.
James could also have won if he had chosen to end the game, but his decision to hold another vote led to his own eviction.
The series also featured two unorthodox confessions, with traitors revealing their own identities before being swiftly removed by the others.
Richard E Grant blurted out his secret role in the second episode because he was so excited to have been selected.
James Acaster, described in the report as the programme's most reluctant traitor, gave himself up under pressure during Thursday's penultimate episode.
An apparently misplaced reaction shot fuelled speculation about how heavily the round-table scene had been edited.
The report suggested that Acaster's confession revived the programme after what some viewers regarded as a mid-series lull.
More than 15 million people had been watching the series.
A Hollywood Reporter article contrasted record-breaking ratings with a perceived consensus on social media that the series had been rather dull.
Some viewers pointed to a shortage of double-crossing and explosive arguments, describing the celebrities as more friendly and strategically aware than earlier groups.
The drama intensified in the final, which the report suggested was likely to have been the year's most watched television programme.

vocabulary.definition: A contest in which success depends on outthinking opponents through reasoning, perception or strategy.
Gradually made smaller through successive removals, emphasising a process rather than a single reduction.
Acting against someone previously treated as an ally, implying a breakdown of loyalty.
Departing from an established or expected approach, without necessarily being forbidden.
Said something suddenly and without sufficient thought, often disclosing information unintentionally.
Stopped concealing his identity and voluntarily admitted his role, allowing others to act against him.
Made an existing reaction or belief stronger, without necessarily providing proof that it was justified.
A temporary period of reduced activity or excitement within a continuing event.
A broadly shared judgement within a group, which need not involve complete agreement.
Deceiving someone who expects your cooperation, especially by secretly acting against their interests.

entries.ja: 推理力、洞察力、戦略などを駆使して知恵で相手を上回ることが、勝敗を左右する競争。
entries.ko: 추론력, 통찰력 또는 전략으로 상대보다 한 수 앞서 생각하는 데 승패가 달린 경쟁.
entries.zh-Hans: 一种较量，能否获胜取决于能否通过推理、洞察或策略在智谋上胜过对手。
entries.es: Competición en la que el éxito depende de superar a los oponentes en ingenio mediante el razonamiento, la percepción o la estrategia.
entries.pt-BR: Disputa em que o sucesso depende de superar os adversários em inteligência por meio do raciocínio, da percepção ou da estratégia.
entries.fr: Compétition où le succès dépend de la capacité à prendre l’avantage sur ses adversaires par le raisonnement, la perspicacité ou la stratégie.
entries.de: Ein Wettstreit, bei dem der Erfolg davon abhängt, den Gegnern durch logisches Denken, Wahrnehmungsvermögen oder Strategie gedanklich überlegen zu sein.

entries.ja: 次々と取り除かれることで徐々に少なくなったこと。一度の減少ではなく、段階的な過程を強調する。
entries.ko: 잇따라 제외되는 과정을 거치며 점차 줄어든 상태로, 한 번의 감소보다 단계적인 과정을 강조한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 经过接连剔除而逐渐减少，强调的是一个过程，而不是一次性的缩减。
entries.es: Reducido gradualmente mediante eliminaciones sucesivas, con énfasis en el proceso y no en una única reducción.
entries.pt-BR: Reduzido aos poucos por meio de eliminações sucessivas, com ênfase no processo, e não em uma única redução.
entries.fr: Progressivement réduit par des éliminations successives, en mettant l’accent sur un processus plutôt que sur une réduction unique.
entries.de: Durch aufeinanderfolgende Entfernungen nach und nach verkleinert, wobei der schrittweise Vorgang und nicht eine einmalige Verringerung betont wird.

entries.ja: それまで味方として扱っていた相手に敵対する行動を取ること。忠誠関係が崩れたことを含意する。
entries.ko: 이전에 자기편으로 대하던 사람에게 적대적으로 행동하는 것으로, 충성 관계가 깨졌음을 내포한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 采取行动对付先前视为盟友的人，暗示彼此的忠诚关系已经破裂。
entries.es: Actuar contra alguien a quien antes se trataba como aliado, lo que implica una ruptura de la lealtad.
entries.pt-BR: Agir contra alguém que antes era tratado como aliado, o que implica uma quebra de lealdade.
entries.fr: Agir contre une personne jusque-là considérée comme une alliée, ce qui implique une rupture de loyauté.
entries.de: Gegen jemanden vorgehen, den man zuvor als Verbündeten behandelt hat, was einen Bruch der Loyalität nahelegt.

entries.ja: 確立された方法や予想されるやり方から外れているが、必ずしも禁じられているわけではない。
entries.ko: 기존에 확립되었거나 예상되는 방식에서 벗어나지만, 반드시 금지된 것은 아니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 偏离既定或预期的做法，但不一定是被禁止的。
entries.es: Que se aparta de una forma de proceder establecida o esperada, sin estar necesariamente prohibido.
entries.pt-BR: Que se afasta de uma maneira de agir estabelecida ou esperada, sem ser necessariamente proibido.
entries.fr: Qui s’écarte d’une façon de faire établie ou attendue, sans être nécessairement interdit.
entries.de: Von einer etablierten oder erwarteten Vorgehensweise abweichend, ohne deshalb zwangsläufig verboten zu sein.

entries.ja: 十分に考えずに突然口にしたこと。意図せず情報を明かしてしまうことが多い。
entries.ko: 충분히 생각하지 않고 갑자기 말을 내뱉었다는 뜻으로, 흔히 의도치 않게 정보를 드러내는 경우에 쓰인다.
entries.zh-Hans: 没有充分思考就突然说了出来，往往会无意中泄露信息。
entries.es: Dijo algo de repente y sin pensarlo lo suficiente, a menudo revelando información sin querer.
entries.pt-BR: Disse algo de repente e sem pensar o suficiente, muitas vezes revelando informações sem querer.
entries.fr: A dit quelque chose brusquement et sans suffisamment réfléchir, révélant souvent une information sans le vouloir.
entries.de: Sagte plötzlich und ohne ausreichend nachzudenken etwas, wobei solche Äußerungen oft unbeabsichtigt Informationen preisgeben.

entries.ja: 自分の正体を隠すのをやめ、自ら役割を認めたことで、他の人が自分に対して行動を起こせるようにした。
entries.ko: 자신의 정체를 숨기는 것을 그만두고 자발적으로 자신의 역할을 인정하여, 다른 사람들이 자신에게 불리한 조치를 취할 수 있게 했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 不再隐瞒自己的身份，并主动承认了自己的角色，使其他人能够采取行动对付他。
entries.es: Dejó de ocultar su identidad y admitió voluntariamente su papel, permitiendo que los demás actuaran contra él.
entries.pt-BR: Parou de esconder sua identidade e admitiu voluntariamente seu papel, permitindo que os outros agissem contra ele.
entries.fr: A cessé de cacher son identité et a volontairement reconnu son rôle, permettant aux autres d’agir contre lui.
entries.de: Hörte auf, seine Identität zu verbergen, und bekannte sich freiwillig zu seiner Rolle, wodurch andere gegen ihn vorgehen konnten.

entries.ja: すでにあった反応や考えをさらに強めたが、それが妥当であるという証拠を必ずしも示したわけではない。
entries.ko: 이미 있던 반응이나 믿음을 더 강하게 만들었지만, 그것이 타당하다는 증거를 반드시 제공한 것은 아니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 使已有的反应或看法更加强烈，但不一定提供了证明其合理的证据。
entries.es: Intensificó una reacción o creencia ya existente, sin aportar necesariamente pruebas de que estuviera justificada.
entries.pt-BR: Intensificou uma reação ou crença já existente, sem necessariamente fornecer provas de que ela era justificada.
entries.fr: A renforcé une réaction ou une conviction déjà présente, sans nécessairement apporter la preuve qu’elle était fondée.
entries.de: Verstärkte eine bereits bestehende Reaktion oder Überzeugung, ohne zwangsläufig Belege dafür zu liefern, dass sie gerechtfertigt war.

entries.ja: 続いている出来事の中で、活動や盛り上がりが一時的に弱まる期間。
entries.ko: 계속 진행 중인 일에서 활동이나 열기가 일시적으로 줄어드는 기간.
entries.zh-Hans: 在持续进行的事件中，活动或兴奋程度暂时降低的一段时间。
entries.es: Periodo temporal de menor actividad o emoción dentro de un acontecimiento que sigue desarrollándose.
entries.pt-BR: Período temporário de menor atividade ou empolgação durante um acontecimento que continua em andamento.
entries.fr: Période temporaire de baisse d’activité ou d’enthousiasme au cours d’un événement qui se poursuit.
entries.de: Eine vorübergehende Phase geringerer Aktivität oder Spannung innerhalb eines fortlaufenden Ereignisses.

entries.ja: ある集団の中で広く共有されている判断。全員が完全に一致している必要はない。
entries.ko: 한 집단 안에서 널리 공유되는 판단으로, 모두가 완전히 동의할 필요는 없다.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个群体中被广泛认同的判断，不一定要求所有人完全一致。
entries.es: Juicio ampliamente compartido dentro de un grupo, que no requiere un acuerdo total.
entries.pt-BR: Avaliação amplamente compartilhada em um grupo, que não exige concordância total.
entries.fr: Jugement largement partagé au sein d’un groupe, sans nécessiter un accord complet.
entries.de: Eine innerhalb einer Gruppe weitgehend geteilte Einschätzung, die keine vollständige Übereinstimmung voraussetzt.

entries.ja: 自分が協力してくれると期待している相手を欺くこと。特に、ひそかに相手の利益に反する行動を取ること。
entries.ko: 자신의 협조를 기대하는 사람을 속이는 행위로, 특히 몰래 그 사람의 이익에 반하는 행동을 하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 欺骗期待你与其合作的人，尤其是暗中采取损害对方利益的行动。
entries.es: Engaño a alguien que espera tu cooperación, especialmente actuando en secreto contra sus intereses.
entries.pt-BR: Ato de enganar alguém que espera sua cooperação, especialmente agindo em segredo contra os interesses dessa pessoa.
entries.fr: Fait de tromper une personne qui s’attend à votre coopération, notamment en agissant secrètement contre ses intérêts.
entries.de: Das Täuschen einer Person, die mit der eigenen Zusammenarbeit rechnet, insbesondere indem man heimlich gegen ihre Interessen handelt.
